description: This file defines the CursoService class, which provides core service methods for managing 'Curso' entities, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving courses within the application. It interacts with the CursoRepository for data access and handles business logic related to the Curso entity.

classes.name: CursoService
classes.description: Service layer class providing operations to create, update, delete, and retrieve 'Curso' entities, handling business logic and interactions with the repository.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new 'Curso' entity from the provided CursoDto after checking for duplicate course names, then saves it to the repository.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing 'Curso' entity identified by 'id_curso' with new data from the 'curso' parameter and saves the changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified 'Curso' entity from the repository.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all 'Curso' entities from the repository.
